integrity: The proof covers all numbers of leaves; finite checks independently enumerate the original confluence axioms through three leaves and permutation-fixed relations through five leaves. No claim of external or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite rooted stars and both base forth-confluence clauses only; no optional serial/reflexive/transitive axiom imposed. Unindexed equivalent classifications remain possible, and exhaustive verification is finite.
title: Exact census of pseudo-classical bi-intuitionistic modal relations on finite rooted stars
